title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00136 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:45: Removed chiksan hoses and control lines from WH/XT.
00:45 - 02:15: Removed hatches on f-5 and f-10. Removed beam between wells.
02:15 - 02:45: Removed elevator from bails. Installed lifting chains to TDS.
02:45 - 03:00: Pulled master bushing and rotary ring. Installed handrail around rotary. Meanwhile performed TBT for lifting XT.
03:00 - 03:15: Lowered lifting equipment from rotary down to moonpool. Attached lifting equipment to XT.
03:15 - 03:30: Removed XT clamp
03:30 - 04:45: Lifted XT into moonpool and landed on skid.
04:45 - 05:00: Secured XT on skid.
05:00 - 06:00: Lowered tuggers down to WH deck. Attached spacer spool to lifting arrangement. Lifted spacer spool from WH deck to drill floor. L/d spacer spool. M/u BPV plug in th. Observed dirt in the th area.
06:00 - 07:00: Installed master bushing. Confirmed no pressure in WH voids. Disconnected control lines on WH and blinded off ports. Meanwhile installed mouse hole and l/o RT. P/u HP riser joint.
07:00 - 07:15: Performed TBT for installing communication collar. Meanwhile measured distance RKB WH 20,0 m.
07:15 - 08:15: Installed communication collar. Meanwhile lifted XT from moonpool to main deck. Performed TBT for installing hatches.
08:15 - 09:45: Installed beam and hatch on f-10.
09:45 - 10:00: Performed TBT for running HP riser joint.
10:00 - 11:15: Ran HP riser joint and set down 2 ton. M/u connector on WH.
11:15 - 11:30: Installed split hatch around riser joint.
11:30 - 13:15: Built scaffolding around riser joint. Meanwhile prepared for running slick joint and diverter. Performed TBT for n/u BOP/DIVERTER.
13:15 - 14:15: Skidded BOP from test stump to well center. Landed BOP on NT-2 connector.
14:15 - 14:30: Built remaining scaffolding around riser joint.
14:30 - 15:00: Installed slick joint.
15:00 - 18:00: Installed tension cylinders. Starboard aft and FWD tension cylinders misaligned to the BOP. Meanwhile m/u BOP NT-2 connector to riser.
18:00 - 18:15: Load shifted

sections.text: Removed chiksan hoses and control lines from WH/XT.
Removed hatches on f-5 and f-10. Removed beam between wells.
Removed elevator from bails. Installed lifting chains to TDS.
Pulled master bushing and rotary ring. Installed handrail around rotary. Meanwhile performed TBT for lifting XT.
Lowered lifting equipment from rotary down to moonpool. Attached lifting equipment to XT.
Removed XT clamp
Lifted XT into moonpool and landed on skid.
Secured XT on skid.
Lowered tuggers down to WH deck. Attached spacer spool to lifting arrangement. Lifted spacer spool from WH deck to drill floor. L/d spacer spool. M/u BPV plug in th. Observed dirt in the th area.
Installed master bushing. Confirmed no pressure in WH voids. Disconnected control lines on WH and blinded off ports. Meanwhile installed mouse hole and l/o RT. P/u HP riser joint.
Performed TBT for installing communication collar. Meanwhile measured distance RKB WH 20,0 m.
Installed communication collar. Meanwhile lifted XT from moonpool to main deck. Performed TBT for installing hatches.
Installed beam and hatch on f-10.
Performed TBT for running HP riser joint.
Ran HP riser joint and set down 2 ton. M/u connector on WH.
Installed split hatch around riser joint.
Built scaffolding around riser joint. Meanwhile prepared for running slick joint and diverter. Performed TBT for n/u BOP/DIVERTER.
Skidded BOP from test stump to well center. Landed BOP on NT-2 connector.
Built remaining scaffolding around riser joint.
Installed slick joint.
Installed tension cylinders. Starboard aft and FWD tension cylinders misaligned to the BOP. Meanwhile m/u BOP NT-2 connector to riser.
Load shifted weight from BOP carrier to tension system.
Ran diverter 0,1 m above slick joint. Aligned slick joint/bop to diverter using tension system and BOP carrier. Landed diverter and disconnected lifting equipment. M/u slick joint.
Performed TBT for working on the slick joint.
Installed master bushing. R/d diverter RT.
N/u slick joint nuts. N/u overshot. Meanwhile prepared tubing handling equipment on drill floor. Liftet casing tong to drill floor. Prepared BPV RT BHA.
De-isolated and pressured up BOP control system. Meanwhile r/u chiksan hoses on WH. Performed TBT for connector test.
Lined up and filled BOP. Performed BOP connector test to 20/345 bar for 5/10 min. Meanwhile continued r/u of chiksan hoses on WH.
RIH with BPV RT on 3 1/2" DP. Latched onto dart and POOH and l/d. Meanwhile continued r/u of chiksan hoses on WH.
RIH with stinger BHA. Pulled BPV plug. POOH and l/d tools. Meanwhile continued r/u of chiksan hoses on WH.
Prepared and r/u casing tong.
